attempts.text:
GAJENDRA JADHAV
Derivatives Trader
+91 9920563289   •   gajendraindex03@gmail.com   •   Dombivali, Maharashtra


SUMMARY
Results-driven Derivatives Trader with experience in options strategies (collars, spreads, calendar spreads), risk-adjusted returns, Greeks interpretation, and 
backtesting. Adept at client relationship management, financial advisory, and identifying new business opportunities.
EXPERIENCE
Trader / Business Development Aug 2025 – Present
Independent  |  Dombivali, Maharashtra
	• Developed and deployed a proprietary algorithmic trading system for Indian equity derivatives (Nifty/BankNifty) and BTC Options, automating strategy 
execution and trade management.
	• Managed algo-based account handling services for clients, running systematic strategies across Indian markets and crypto (BTC Options) with defined 
risk parameters per account.
	• Onboarded and serviced clients by providing transparent performance reporting, strategy walkthroughs, and ongoing support — driving business 
growth through referrals and retention.
	• Continuously backtested and optimized algo logic to adapt to changing market conditions across both Indian derivatives and global BTC options 
markets.

Trader May 2025 – July 2025
NU Fintech  |  Thane, Maharashtra
	• Executed Collars, Bull Call Spreads, and Bull Put Spreads to generate consistent risk-adjusted returns.
	• Monitored Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega) and macro events to adjust positions and optimize performance.
	• Backtested historical data to refine entry/exit points, reducing drawdowns and improving win rates.

Derivative Trader Feb 2024 – April 2025
Mansukh Securities  |  Thane, Maharashtra
	• Developed Calendar Spread strategies capitalizing on time decay and implied volatility shifts.
	• Applied Nifty Straddle-based Calendar Spreads across expiries; leveraged volatility during earnings & macro events.
	• Monitored live order flow, market sentiment, and risk exposure to support strategic decision-making.

Financial Advisor Jan 2023 – Mar 2023
Motilal Oswal  |  Mumbai, India
	• Advised clients on equity, mutual funds, and portfolio management aligned with individual financial goals.
	• Built client base through relationship management; used research reports and analytics for informed decisions.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Commerce Jun 2022
Model College  |  Dombivali, Maharashtra
CORE SKILLS
Technical Analysis   •   Intraday Trading   •   Risk Management   •   Market Trend Analysis
MS Office   •   Decision Making   •   Problem Solving   •   Analytical Thinking   •   Organization Skills
	CERTIFICATIONS

	• NISM-Series-VIII: Equity Derivatives Certification

	LANGUAGES

English  •  Hindi  •  Marathi
